name: Fabric Embroidered Patch
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made with a premium fabric base combined with high-quality embroidery stitching for a textured and durable finish.
    - Features dense embroidery threads that create a detailed, dimensional appearance with vibrant colors.
    - Available in two backing options:
             +  Sew-On Patch: Designed to be stitched onto garments or accessories by hand or sewing machine.
             +  Iron-On Patch: Equipped with a heat-activated adhesive backing for easy application.
    - Custom shape cut to match the design, providing a professional and eye-catching look.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes:
    3 × 3 in ~ 9 × 9 cm
    4 × 4 in ~ 10.16 × 10.16 cm
    5 × 5 in ~ 12.7 × 12.7 cm
    6 × 6 in ~ 15.24 × 15.24 cm
    7 × 7 in ~ 17.78 × 17.78 cm
    8 × 8 in ~ 20.32 × 20.32 cm
    9 × 9 in ~ 22.86 × 22.86 cm
    📌 Note: The sizes listed are for the largest dimension of the patch. Final measurements depend on the aspect ratio of your design.

 

  • Embroidery Technology:
    - Produced using premium embroidery technology with detailed stitching and vibrant thread colors.
    - One-sided embroidered design with a textured and dimensional finish.
    - Precision-cut custom shapes provide a clean and professional appearance.
    - Available in Sew-On and Iron-On options for easy application.
    - Durable embroidery maintains its appearance through regular use.

 

  • 📌 Selling Price:
    - This product has NO stitch surcharge and NO embroidery file conversion fee.
    - The embroidery cost is based on the number of embroidery areas selected by the customer, according to the public price on the Printway system.
     
  • Design File/Embroidery Notes:
    📌 Please carefully read the guidelines for preparing embroidery files or PNG files and the design requirements/limitations before submitting your artwork to ensure the best quality outcome. Please read more details here.
    📌 Important Note: To ensure the embroidery product is clear and detailed, the smallest separate elements and details in your design should be at least 2mm in size.
    - Designs with text:
            + The minimum height should be 1 cm.
            + Maintain a minimum letter spacing of 1.5 mm to ensure clean embroidery and clear readability.
            + Avoid using very thin fonts, especially small serif fonts or script fonts.
    - Thread colors: Compatible with embroidery files that contain up to 8 different thread colors.
    - Avoid designs with:
            + Photographic or gradient-based images,
            + Overly complex or dimensional graphics.
    - Recommended styles:
             + Simple text (bold, sans-serif fonts).
             + Monoline designs.
             + Flat/simple shapes without excessive detail.

 

  • Care Instructions:
    - For Iron-On Patches, wait at least 24 hours after application before washing.
    - Turn garments inside out before washing.
    - Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle.
    - Do not use bleach or harsh detergents.
    - Air dry whenever possible for maximum longevity.
    - Avoid direct ironing on the embroidered surface; place a protective cloth over the patch if ironing is necessary.
    - For heavy-use garments, additional stitching is recommended to enhance durability.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Perfect for personalizing jackets, hats, backpacks, tote bags, uniforms, jeans, hoodies, and other fabric items.
    - Great for showcasing team logos, club emblems, school spirit, military commemorations, sports achievements, brand identities, and custom artwork.
    - Helps repair or cover worn areas on clothing while adding a unique decorative element.
    - Durable enough for everyday use and long-term display.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A unique and personalized gift suitable for people of all ages.
    - Ideal for birthdays, graduations, anniversaries, reunions, team events, holidays, memorials, and special celebrations.
    - Great for students, athletes, military veterans, club members, coworkers, friends, and family members.
    - Custom designs transform meaningful memories, logos, names, and artwork into lasting keepsakes.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Fabric Embroidered Patch

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
